features.title: Un-Junked Diwali Gifts
features.text: Don’t leave room for guilt in a house full of lights, love, and your favorite snacks. Un-Junk your celebrations with Premium Diwali Gift Hampers from Open Secret.

features.title: About Open Secret
features.text: Open Secret is a brand for mothers, made by mothers! Open Secret is a purpose-led brand on a mission to make every Indian family snack better by Un-Junking their favourite snacks! Here you can find the ideal balance of taste & health! All the products are made with healthier ingredients to improvise your favourite snacks without compromising the taste!

features.title: Premium Diwali Gift Hampers
features.text: Get Premium Diwali Gift Hampers with the delicious goodness of Nuts, Festive Essentials, and a lot of love! Add a personal touch to the gift with a handwritten note for your loved ones. Open Secret’s Diwali gifts for friends and family are the perfect gift to make every little moment count! Indulge in the sweetness of cookies and chocolates to make your special celebrations delicious! Light up the faces of those who work hard each day with Diwali gifts for employees. Let the festivities begin by gifting love and light to your near and dear ones.

summary.text: Customers find these cookies delicious with three different flavors and appreciate their nutritional value as a relatively healthy dessert option. They are good for gifting, though customers note they are smaller than usual cookies. Customers find the cookies not worth the price.

authors_reviews.title: Overpriced Chikki
authors_reviews.text: I had first bought this product to send as a Rakhi gift to my brothers living far away. The feedback I got was good. So, I decided to get myself a box too.INGREDIENTS 4/5: The description says No Maida, so I thought they might be using a gluten free substitute. Turns out, it is a cookie which is more like a Energy bar - Mix of nut, chocolate and rice crisps or oats or granola. The base is chocolate for some structure and then there are other stuff stuck on it bonded with Chocolate.TASTE 4/5: Overall, the taste is good. It is a relatively healthy dessert than actual cookies. So, good for a sweet tooth on diet.PACKAGING 1/5: The packaging is excessive! A thin cardboard box, a cardboard cover encasing just two cookies in a plastic wrap each. While, it was nice for a gift hamper but unnecessary for usual consumptionOVERALL 3.5/5: Cool concept, but overpriced for what it is. I would make my own or buy a chikki from a local shop to get similar satisfaction.
